array.string:
set -euo pipefail
home="${HOME:-/Users/aloksubbarao}" server_dir="${RELOAD_SERVER_DIR:-$home/duckdb-skills/server}" state_dir="${RELOAD_STATE_DIR:-$home/.duck/local}" snapshot_file="$state_dir/reload-source.snapshot" log_file="${RELOAD_LOG:-$home/.duck/logs/reload-events.log}" target="${RELOAD_TARGET:-gui/$(id -u)/com.inframe.quack}"
mkdir -p "$state_dir" "$(dirname "$log_file")" current_snapshot="$(mktemp "$state_dir/.reload-current.XXXXXX")" raw_changes="$(mktemp "$state_dir/.reload-changes.XXXXXX")" changed_paths="$(mktemp "$state_dir/.reload-paths.XXXXXX")" loadable_paths="$(mktemp "$state_dir/.reload-loadable.XXXXXX")" skipped_paths="$(mktemp "$state_dir/.reload-skipped.XXXXXX")" trap 'rm -f "$current_snapshot" "$raw_changes" "$changed_paths" "$loadable_paths" "$skipped_paths"' EXIT
# WatchPaths only tells launchd that something changed. The snapshot lets this # invocation classify the changed paths without restarting for every file type. find "$server_dir" -type f -exec stat -f '%m %z %N' {} + 2>/dev/null | sort > "$current_snapshot" if [ -f "$snapshot_file" ]; then comm -3 "$snapshot_file" "$current_snapshot" > "$raw_changes" else comm -3 /dev/null "$current_snapshot" > "$raw_changes" fi
while IFS= read -r entry; do entry="${entry# }" path="${entry#* }" path="${path#* }" if [ -n "$path" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$path" >> "$changed_paths" fi done < "$raw_changes" sort -u "$changed_paths" -o "$changed_paths"
while IFS= read -r path; do case "$path" in *.sql|*.tera) printf '%s\n' "$path" >> "$loadable_paths" ;; *) printf '%s\n' "$path" >> "$skipped_paths" ;; esac done < "$changed_paths"
mv "$current_snapshot" "$snapshot_file" timestamp="$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')"
while IFS= read -r path; do printf 'timestamp=%s event=skipped file=%s reason=not-loaded target=%s\n' "$timestamp" "$path" "$target" >> "$log_file" done < "$skipped_paths"
if [ -s "$loadable_paths" ]; then loadable_files="$(paste -sd, "$loadable_paths")" if [ "${RELOAD_DRY_RUN:-0}" = "1" ]; then printf 'timestamp=%s event=triggered files=%s target=%s action=dry-run\n' "$timestamp" "$loadable_files" "$target" >> "$log_file" else printf 'timestamp=%s event=triggered files=%s target=%s action=kickstart\n' "$timestamp" "$loadable_files" "$target" >> "$log_file" exec /bin/launchctl kickstart -k "$target" fi fi
